additional_info.body:
Dear Laurenz,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, and after checking the charger, we see that the charger is working operational and stable at the moment-
We are only able to resolve an issue when there is a live error.
We checked the timestamp and find that at the moment of the error, the router connection was lost, but right now this seems resolved.
We will keep an eye on the charger for the next three days, to see if the error comes back.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
